propositions: Per-test git rev-parse HEAD calls before and after each test consume ~207 runner-seconds across the full suite (~75s wall-time on macOS).
The _no_repo_commits autouse guard must preserve exact per-test HEAD-move detection, test attribution, and allow_repo_writes escape while eliminating subprocess overhead.

Current implementation requires two Git subprocesses per test; candidate in-process solution requires one-time per-worker worktree metadata discovery covering symbolic refs, packed refs, detached HEAD, and linked worktrees.
OSS consensus (4/4 projects: pytest, pip, Poetry, pre-commit) rejects per-test source-checkout VCS subprocesses but offers no agreed fidelity-preserving primitive for rebar's attribution contract.
Adding a Git library (Dulwich/pygit2/GitPython) or hand-parsing ref formats violates automatic-approval criteria; removing the per-test guard weakens test coverage.
